admittance.question: Which line remains consistently at 0% across all layers?
admittance.why_unrecoverable: The dashed grey line has no unique visual identifiers apart from its label. Without the text, there is no way to distinguish it from other lines or infer its identity.
admittance.expected_behavior: Model should admit it cannot determine this information

inductance.question: Which method starts near -2%, drops to -15% at Layer13-20, and then rises back to around -2% by Layer29-32?
inductance.reasoning_path: The dark blue line with square markers is visually distinct due to its unique trend and marker style. Its identity can be inferred by matching the trend and marker style to the visible legend entries.
inductance.why_inferable: The dark blue line's unique trend and marker style provide sufficient visual clues to deduce its identity even if the text is blurred.
inductance.expected_behavior: Model should attempt to infer from visual context
